definitions.explanation: The latter portion of a period of time, event, game, or work. The opposite of 前半 (first half).

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{後半|こうはん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The second half of the game has begun.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{後半|こうはん}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to move in the second half of this year.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}は{後半|こうはん}になるにつれて{展開|てんかい}が{加速|かそく}していく。
examples.english: As the movie enters its latter half, the plot picks up speed.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently used with time periods ({年|ねん}の{後半|こうはん}, {月|つき}の{後半|こうはん}), games and matches ({試合|しあい}の{後半|こうはん}), and creative works ({映画|えいが}の{後半|こうはん}, {小説|しょうせつ}の{後半|こうはん}). Also used with decades: 1990{年代|ねんだい}{後半|こうはん} (the late 1990s).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前半|ぜんはん}と{後半|こうはん}: first half and second half
- {年|ねん}の{後半|こうはん}: the second half of the year
- {後半|こうはん}に{入|はい}る: to enter the second half
- {後半|こうはん}{戦|せん}: the second half (of a season or competition)
